spans.s:
द्यावाक्षमा f. always dual, (-मे) Heaven and earth.
 E. द्यौ heaven, क्षमा the
earth, form irr.; also similar compounds, as द्यावापृथिवी, द्यावा-
भूमी, &c.

द्यावापृथिवी f. always dual, (-व्यौ) Heaven and earth.
 E. द्यौ heaven, and
पृथिवी the earth: see the preceding.

द्यावाभूमी f. always dual, (-भ्यौ) Heaven and earth.
 E. द्यौ, and भूमी the
earth: see the two words preceding.
